title: introduce-policy-safelist-manager-and-audit-compact-proxy
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a Policy Safelist Manager and an Audit Compact Proxy to enforce preflight checks for RBAC v2 policy changes, reduce audit ingest cost by residency-aware segmentation and compact KMS-wrapped audit envelopes. Motivation: we observed multiple operator-initiated policy rollouts that accidentally granted broad operator scopes; combined with growing audit volumes from multi-region tenants this was increasing storage and egress costs and making post-hoc compliance proofs noisy. This PR implements (1) a safelist preflight that runs on policy PRs and flags disallowed wide-scope bindings (configurable by geozone) and exposes a CLI hook (rbacctl safelist) for scripted approvals; (2) an audit-compact-proxy service that shards audit envelopes by data-residency tag, compacts repetitive event payloads into delta-encoded blobs and optionally wraps segments with region-preferred KMS providers for fast local verification; (3) a migration tool to reconcile existing audit blobs into the new segmented format with integrity proofs for continuity. The description below includes rollout strategy, tests, and operational notes. Rollout: feature-flagged (rbac.safelist and audit.compact_proxy) with a canary in us-west-2; policy preflight initially runs in dry-run mode and posts a structured check comment on PRs. After one week of canary validation we will flip enforcement and enable automated compacting in the audit-forwarder pipeline. Backwards compatibility: audit-compact-proxy exposes a compatibility endpoint (v1/envelopes/legacy-proxy) and the migration tool emits verification reports. Security: KMS selector maps tenant geozone to preferred KMS provider, but falls back to multi-provider envelope when policy allows. Audit proofing uses HMAC+KMS-wrapped keys for non-repudiation. See linked Linear items for acceptance criteria and rollout playbook.

review_comments: Liam Chen (review): The safelist rules look good, but we should be explicit about how operator-scoped role templates are treated. Suggest adding a template whitelist and a clear denylist for 'cluster-admin'-like grants to tenant-scoped services.

Maya Patel (reply): Added a rule-template whitelist and a denylist check. The validator now emits a structured reason string that the CLI surfaces. Updated tests to cover tenant-scoped vs operator-scoped cases.
Priya Rao (review): For the audit-compact-proxy, we need a backpressure plan when downstream S3/archive is slow. Can we batch segments and use SLO-aware retries?
Maya Patel (reply): Implemented batch windowing with max_batch_bytes and SLO-aware exponential backoff. See compact_proxy config comments (infra/helm).
Diego Alvarez (review): Migration tool looks heavy — has to be safe for long-tail tenants. Add a dry-run mode that outputs per-tenant verification report and a rollback plan.

Maya Patel (reply): Migration tool now supports --dry-run and emits per-tenant JSON reports with proof hashes and suggested replays. Also added a migration-check job for k8s to run a sample tenant before global migration.
Liam Chen (approve): Verified validator catches rule violations and CLI flow is ergonomic. Integration tests exercise KMS selector behavior across us-west/us-east/eu regions. Approving.
Priya Rao (approve): Audit segmentation e2e looks stable after increasing timeout; performance impact acceptable in canary. Approving.
merge_outcome: squash and merge — commits squashed into feature/safelist-audit-seg-276509; merge performed after approvals and green CI
release_notes: Adds Policy Safelist Manager (RBAC preflight checks + rbacctl safelist CLI) and Audit Compact Proxy (residency-aware audit segmentation, delta compaction, KMS regional wrapping). Feature-flagged rollout; migration tool included. Admins should review runbooks/docs before enabling enforcement.
